planets.name: TOI-1801 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1801 with a 10.6-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1801 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1801. Its orbit and size follow Mallorquín et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
